notes.title: BIG UPDATE
notes.content:
Dear friends!

A bunch of cutscenes have been added to the game, intro + victory cutscene for each location, as well as some bonus ones! We also fixed some minor bugs.

Now you can watch any cutscene through the main menu!


 Help Emperor Vladimir Defend Saint Petersburg from the Lizards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/02a426241889e962032e7aec2213fca6b72af420.png
 The United Lizard Flotillas of Nibiru and Mars have attacked Earth! Go on a journey and destroy the lizard bases!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/f8a25b24e07620286d40829d048e0aec10c047bb.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/94e4f4af6e7a5761beac62092cef5abd54c33dec.png
 Celebrate the New Year 2024 with Emperor Vladimir, God Perun and the knights - Billyslav Herringtonov and Ivan Darkholmov
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/c483ecae1effbfbee64c2ee700eab6b4927016e6.png
 Go to Sauna with the Great Russian Knights ♂

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/dff632b809b7f1514c4e5358c92ffca5b114ba26.png

And more other cutscenes!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/8abb4194e6169b0319cca21941dc0b5178580ca1.png

Play and if you like it, please tell all your friends if you haven't already! And also we remind you that the game has a 40% discount, give your friends a great gift for the new year! Thanks!

notes.title: GIveaway of 2x Steam Gift Cards and 100+ Keys
notes.content:
Hey, friends!

UPD:

Friends, let's summarize the results:

Anyone who participated in the raffle can email dungeon.master.studio@gmail.com and get the keys for participating! Attach a link to your post to the message.

Steam gift cards get numbers:
#57 - https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199523941803
#18 - https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198416140897

- friend the https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199042696187/ and get your steam gift cards!

The numbers were generated using random.org


Receipt of the prize is relevant for the next 7 days! Who will write later than January 21 - 21:00 Moscow time - will not get the prize! Have a nice day!

Thank you all for participating! Good luck in future giveaways.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/1e9475f930633edaedeafb756477ee91ffc41dc4.gif

Today we would like to start a Giveaway:
 $5 Steam Gift Cards x2

 100+ Steam Keys


These prizes are Waiting For You! :)

Friends, to take part in the giveaway, you should:

[olist]
 Add the game to your Steam Wishlist (if it is not already in your Steam library)

 Share this announcement with all who you knows! :)
Click "Share" under this news, then "Share directly to my status", write something and click "Post"

 Tell us your opinion about the game in the comments under this announcement! We will be very happy to hear it from you!

[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/6eafadb50d5228926cad543fe55acb1c4a5350c0.png

We will announce the results of the giveaway on January 14 at 21:00 Moscow time! Good luck!

Guys, we also would like to remind you in a friendly manner that we, as you are waiting for, and really want to get that trading cards and add new levels to the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/c6fc205a521911a3c61f70551263d680f9445968.gif

But the development of the game in terms of adding trading cards, new levels, features and much more depends entirely on your activity - the number of additions of the game to the wishlist, the activity on the store page & in the discussions of the game, the number of game launches, the time spent in the game. All this affects to how fast we'll get trading cards and this helps us to get them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/8d5cdaacceb9c39dc6400085decd2778a68172b5.gif

We will be very grateful if you tell your friends about the game, write your opinion in comments or reviews and Add it to Your Wishlist if you're liked it!

Thanks!
Trading Cards for House of Lizards

Discussions

Your game feedback are encouraged! :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/6b3b22420da5fa4a662a23293582cd22cf51cdd4.png
